hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */config/*.json ]] || [[ "$f" == */config/**/*.json ]]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"[Hook] 配置文件已修改。请查阅 docs/index/configmap.md 确认所有消费者已适配。\"}}"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */internal/render/vfx/*.go ]]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"[Hook] VFX 文件已修改。请同步更新：(1) config/visuals/vfx.json 元数据 (2) vfx_preview.go trigger registry\"}}"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
